name: Varbase AI
description: A collection of AI-tool recipes for the Varbase distribution (editorial AI capabilities).
project_description:
Varbase AI is an advanced collection of AI-driven tools designed to empower editorial teams with intelligent automation, content generation, image optimization, and taxonomy management.

 
 It enables seamless integration and management of custom AI functionalities within Varbase, supporting updatable AI workflows to enhance efficiency and user experience.

 
 
 Varbase AI Recipes 
 By installing the Varbase AI module, the site initially includes the Default Varbase AI Recipe, with additional optional recipes available for further AI-powered enhancements.

 Below are the available AI recipes, each designed to extend the capabilities of Varbase AI:

 
 Varbase AI Default Recipe 
 A foundational recipe that configures default AI modules, settings, and permissions within Varbase. It enables OpenAI integrations for automatic alt-text generation, CKEditor enhancements, and other AI-powered features.

 
 
 Varbase AI Editor Assistant Recipe 
 Enhances the Drupal CKEditor 5 experience by integrating AI-powered writing assistance, grammar refinement, and content generation to improve editorial workflow.

 
 
 Varbase AI Image Alt Recipe 
 Utilizes AI to automatically generate alt text for images, improving accessibility and SEO rankings, ensuring compliance with web accessibility standards.

 
 
 Varbase AI Taxonomy Tagging Recipe 
 AI-powered automated tagging of taxonomy terms based on content analysis, improving searchability and metadata structure for better content organization.

 
 
 Varbase AI Agents Recipe 
 Introduces AI-powered virtual assistants for streamlined site administration, allowing management of multiple AI agents with distinct functionalities.

 
 
 

 
 Varbase AI seamlessly integrates with any Drupal 10/11 site, whether installed with the Minimal or Standard profile. However, using it with Varbase unlocks additional powerful features and AI-enhanced capabilities.
